描述_EN: it has two small holes for a cord and would have been worn as a pendant. a jade in the shape of a half-disc, like this piece, is called a ‘huang’. an ancient chinese text entitled the ‘zhouli’ ('rituals of zhou') describes the ‘huang’ as a ceremonial object to sacrifice to the direction north. this example, however, was made at least a thousand years before the ‘zhouli’ was written.
描述_ZN: 它有两个小孔，可以系上绳子，可以作为一个吊坠佩戴。 像这样的半圆盘形状的玉器，被称为 "璜"。 一篇题为 "周礼 "的中国古籍将 "璜 "描述为祭祀北方的礼器。 这个例子是在《周礼》成书前至少一千年制作的。
